OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
Agenda PDF
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86725966493
Zoom Meeting ID: 867 2596 6493
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 867 2596 6493#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting, please utilize the "Raise Hand" feature during the meeting, or email CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards.

OLD BUSINESS
6.
Reconsideration of the South Bay Cities Council of Governments' (SBCCOG) $4,000 Special Assessment to Hire a Planner
Recommendation: Provide direction to the City Manager regarding payment of a $4,000 special assessment from the South Bay Cities Council of Governments (SBCCOG) to hire a Planner to work with cities on land use issues, monitor and interpret housing legislation, and enhance the SBCCOG's climate action work.
Staff Report
7.
Adoption of Resolution R21-20: (1) Rescinding Resolution R21-19 and (2) Approving the Purchase of a Replacement Police Administration Vehicle in an Amount Not-To-Exceed $35,000; (3) Making an Appropriation of AB 2766 Subvention Funds in the Amount of $35,000.00; and (4) Authorizing the City Manager to Execute Related Documents on Behalf of the City and the City Support Services Director to Make Such Accounting Entries for this Purchase as Deemed Appropriate.
Recommendation: Adopt Resolution R21-20: (1) rescinding Resolution R21-19: (2) approving the purchase of a replacement police administration vehicle in an amount not-to-exceed $35,000; (3) making an appropriation from the AB 2766 Subvention Fund not to exceed $35,000.00; and (4) authorizing the City Manager to execute related documents on behalf of the City and the City Support Services Director to make such accounting entries for this purchase as deemed appropriate.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
8.
Approval of a One-Year Supplemental Law Enforcement Jail Services Agreement with the City of Redondo Beach for an Amount Not-to-Exceed $44,500
Recommendation: Approve a one-year Supplemental Law Enforcement Jail Services Agreement with the City of Redondo Beach for an amount not to exceed $44,500.
Staff Report
9.
Retroactively Authorize the City Manager to Approve Payments Totaling $12,485.49 in Lieu of Earned and Unused Vacation Time to Members of Sworn Police Management
Recommendation: 1) Retroactively authorize the City Manager to approve payments totaling $12,485.49 to compensate members of Police Management in lieu of earned, unused vacation and reduce the employees' accrued vacation banks by the number of hours compensated; 2) Direct the City Manager, when administering employee compensation and benefits, to strictly adhere to the language specified in MOUs and Resolutions of the City Council; and, 3) Update for consistency, via the collective bargaining process, the vacation use language across all Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs) and Resolutions.
Staff Report
10.
Consideration of Resolution No. R21-21, A Vote of No Confidence in Los Angeles District Attorney George Gascón; and/or Participation in Joining the Other Peninsula Cities in a Letter Citing Concerns Regarding Special Directive Policies Impacting Public Safety
Recommendation: The City Council discuss the information provided and determine whether they: 1) wish to adopt Resolution No. R21-21, a Vote of No Confidence in Los Angeles County District Attorney George Gascón; and/or 2) wish to join the other Peninsula Cities in a letter citing concerns regarding special directive policies impacting public safety.
Staff Report
MAYOR AND COUNCILMEMBER REPORTS
This portion of the agenda is reserved for the Mayor and Councilmembers to provide comments, report on community activities and ad hoc committees, and propose topics to be calendared on a future Council agenda.
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, June 8, 2021 AT 6:30 P.M.
